status: candidate after Codex review; conditional SPOC calibration passes, end-to-end and amended implementation unqualified; not frozen
question: How well do issued ExoClock DRD ephemerides predict later independent TESS mid-times, and does a population calibration learned from the previous release improve the predictive distribution?
availability_basis: OSF public-node and exact-file logs: DRD public 2025-11-18 09:43:24 UTC (D043); first whole UTC day

forecasts.M0: issued DRD linear ephemeris; Gaussian with C2 reconstructed T0-P correlation (not an issued covariance)
forecasts.M2: M0 forecast variance x latent lognormal multiplier exp(s z), median 1
forecasts.M3: M0 forecast variance x b^2 x latent lognormal multiplier exp(s z)

covariance_tiers.C3_source_fit_mismatch: otherwise; flagged, retained, sensitivity without C3

forecasts.parameter_rule: release transfer: fit M1-M3 on DRC forecasts against t015v3 outcomes after DRC issue (2022-09-28 to 2024-01-03), the full development record; no regularisation prior

outcomes.rule: frozen t015v3 SPOC conditional replication passes after correcting analysis (C028); amended integration handling and end-to-end identification not qualified
outcomes.products: SPOC 120-s PDCSAP where it exists for the sector, otherwise TESS-SPOC 200-s PDCSAP; paired products never both scored
outcomes.identification: BLS within the issued DRD period +/-0.5%, epoch blind, depth SNR >= 7, other DRD planets masked
outcomes.failures: every attempted event retained with status; scoring conditional on timed; recovery reported separately and never imputed
outcomes.qualified_population: none for end-to-end evaluation; frozen single-DRD-planet SPOC conditional calibration passes; FFI and multi-planet extension not qualified
outcomes.transit_count_scope: No restriction adopted; original successful-injection count explanation was partly a product-selection artifact

scores.primary: planet-balanced IS95 divided by the common M0 predictive SD (forecast plus outcome error); M2 minus M0
scores.decision_interval: 95% host-cluster percentile bootstrap of the planet-balanced paired difference, B = 10000, parameters fixed
scores.parameter_uncertainty: re-score with the 400 development host-refit parameter sets; reported, not part of the decision
scores.decision: improves if the interval is below zero, worsens if above, otherwise inconclusive

amendments: any change after freeze is dated and justified in coordination/decisions.md; the frozen analysis is reported first and in full
time_boundary_qualification: Five of 3399 opportunities lie within ten minutes of unconverted numeric metadata boundaries and are unresolved; a safety margin is not a validated astronomical conversion
